ZmlXZjJ5MC1INjlybldkT0FBQUFBQT09OkVzd0JD.job_description:
Position Overview

A Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) is responsible for providing one-on-one behavioral interventions to individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and other developmental disabilities. Under the supervision of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), the RBT implements treatment plans using Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) techniques to promote skill development and reduce challenging behaviors.

Responsibilities
• Implement Behavior Plans: Follow treatment plans designed by the BCBA to help clients develop skills and manage behaviors.
• Direct Client Interaction: Work one-on-one with clients in home, school, clinic, or community settings.
• Data Collection: Timely and accurately record and track progress based on behavioral data.
• Skill Development: Help clients improve in areas such as communication, social skills, daily living skills, and academics.
• Crisis Management: Use de-escalation techniques to handle challenging behaviors safely.
• Parent & Caregiver Training: Assist families by providing strategies to reinforce skills outside of sessions.
• Collaboration: Communicate with BCBAs, teachers, therapists, and families to ensure consistent implementation of interventions.
• Ethical Compliance: Follow all Behavior Analyst Certification Board (BACB) guidelines, HIPAA regulations, and company policies on ethical compliance.

Requirements, Qualifications & Skills
• Active RBT certification from the Behavior Analyst Certification Board (BACB).
• High school diploma or equivalent
• Experience working with children, individuals with ASD or developmental disabilities is preferred.
• Ability to pass a background check and obtain CPR certification.
• Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Join us as the field leader who helps our RBTs deliver consistent, high-quality ABA for every family.

Why Work at DM Behavioral Solutions?

• Competitive Compensation: $23 - $27 per hour, based on your experience, education, and certifications, paid biweekly by direct deposit.

• Full-Time Stability: Full-time, Monday to Friday, with a weekly mentoring block. We build your caseload around your availability and neighborhood.

• Health and Wellness: Our PreventivePay wellness program gives you 24/7 virtual urgent care, unlimited virtual doctor visits, and ongoing virtual primary care, with no waiting rooms.

• Mental Health Support: Confidential counseling with licensed mental health counselors, plus unlimited wellness support groups: yoga, sleep coaching, emotional resilience, whole-body wellness coaching, therapeutic art, grief and loss, managing chronic pain, quitting nicotine, a men’s group, and parenting support for moms.

• Tuition Discount: Through our partnership with Purdue University Global, you and your immediate family (spouse or partner, children, parents, and siblings) save 14% on any graduate program and 20% on any undergraduate program, in fields like psychology and ABA, health sciences, nursing, business, education, human services, and information technology.

• Leadership Time: Protected mentoring time built into your week.

• Career Growth: First in line for our Student Analyst (RBT to BCBA) program and BCaBA openings.

• Mileage: Reimbursed between client locations at the current IRS rate.

• Impactful Work: Help a child say a first word, make a friend, or get through the day with more independence.

A Day in the Life of a Lead Registered Behavior Technician

As a Lead RBT, you are the go-to person in the field. You run your own ABA sessions with families, and you are also the RBT other RBTs call when a program or a behavior gets tricky. You model procedures for newer technicians, cover sessions when a teammate is out, and give your BCBA a front-line read on how each case is really going.

Every month you help shadow new hires, support treatment-integrity checks, and share what you see with our Clinical Director so quality stays high across the team. You love teaching as much as you love therapy, and you take pride in watching the RBTs you mentor grow into confident clinicians.

What Would You Be Doing?

• Delivers ABA sessions with an assigned caseload under BCBA direction.

• Models procedures and gives in-the-field feedback to newer RBTs.

• Covers sessions when teammates are out and supports high-need cases.

• Helps with new-hire shadowing, treatment-integrity checks, and team trainings.

• Shares front-line observations with BCBAs and the Clinical Director.

• Completes accurate data and session notes in ABA Matrix within 24 hours (48 hours at most).

• Maintains client confidentiality and follows DM policies and the RBT Ethics Code.

What Do You Bring to the Role?

• Certification: Current RBT certification in good standing.

• Experience: Five or more years of direct ABA experience (ten or more years for the top of the pay range).

• Experience: Experience mentoring or training other RBTs.

• Transportation: Valid Florida driver license, reliable car, and auto insurance.

• Background: Ability to pass a Florida Level 2 background screening.

• Passion for Children: A genuine love for working with kids and families.

• Positive Attitude: Patience, reliability, and strong communication with families and teammates.

Are you the person other technicians ask for help? Do you give feedback in a way that builds people up? Are your data and session notes always clean and on time? Can you stay calm and lead when a session gets hard? If so, you might just be perfect for this Lead RBT position!

RBT Success Profile

• Functional and Technical ABA Skills: Baseline mastery of discrete trial training, prompt fading, reinforcement, and data collection.

• Ethics and Integrity: Upholding client rights, confidentiality, and the BACB Ethics Code.

• Seeking Help and Receiving Feedback: Recognizing your limits, asking your supervisor for guidance early, and accepting feedback constructively.

• Dealing Behaviorally with Stress: Identifying personal stressors and using self-management to maintain your stamina.

• Composure: Staying calm and objective during challenging behavior or crisis situations.

• Business Etiquette and Professionalism: Punctuality, professional appearance, and proper communication in homes and schools.

• Approachability and Listening: Putting clients, caregivers, and colleagues at ease while actively hearing their concerns.

• Customer Focus and Caregiver Rapport: Communicating with parents with empathy and without overwhelming technical jargon.

• Patience: Keeping the right pace during slow skill acquisition and staying tolerant under pressure.

• Time Management and Preparedness: Organizing session materials in advance and managing session time efficiently.

• Think Function: Viewing client and caregiver behavior through an environmental, function-based lens.

• Becoming a Trusted Professional: Showing reliability, consistency, and follow-through to build trust with families and your team.

• Learning on the Fly and Adaptability: Quickly learning new client protocols and adjusting when session dynamics change.

Physical Requirements:

This role involves working in homes, schools, and community settings, occasionally lifting or moving up to 30 lbs., sitting on the floor, bending, kneeling, and engaging in active play for extended periods. Travel between client locations is required.

Who Are We?

DM Behavioral Solutions is a South Florida ABA therapy provider serving children and families across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach. From our office in Pembroke Pines, our bilingual team delivers family-centered ABA at home, at school, and in the community, and coaches caregivers so progress continues between sessions.

We are big enough to keep your schedule full and small enough that you will know our Clinical Director by name. We believe the people who care for kids deserve care too, which is why every team member gets real supervision, a clear path to grow, and a wellness program that supports both mind and body.

For more information, please visit www.dmbehavioralsolutions.com.

Ready to Join Our Team?

A Day in the Life of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA)

As a BCBA at D & M, you are the clinical leader for your caseload. Your days combine supervision visits and direct work with families, data review on ABA Matrix, and quick check-ins with your RBTs. Every month you complete progress reports and authorization packets with help from our operations team, which also handles payer credentialing with you, and you review cases with our Clinical Director. Total Competence in ABA and Program Design: Conducting functional assessments, designing DTT and NET programs, analyzing data, and staying current with the research.

Job Title: Registered Behavior Technician (RBT)

Location: North Miami, FL

Who We Are

At MOD Behavior ABA, we believe our team members are the most important part of our organization—especially our RBTs and BTs! We are a tech-forward, family-focused company dedicated to using proven ABA principles to bring lasting, positive change to the lives of our clients.

We are currently seeking a qualified, dedicated, and compassionate Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) to provide in-home, school, and community-based Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA) services. You will be a critical part of our team, helping children, youth, and young adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder or other developmental disabilities build skills and reduce challenging behaviors.

What You'll Do

As an RBT, you will work directly with clients under the supervision of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) to:

• Provide Direct Intervention: Implement 1:1 behavior intervention and skill acquisition plans designed by the BCBA.

• Collect & Document Data: Meticulously collect, record, and graph data on client progress and behaviors.

• Complete Session Notes: Write accurate, objective, and timely treatment notes for each session.

• Collaborate & Communicate: Assist clients with daily activities, communicate effectively with families/caregivers, and attend regular team meetings.

• Uphold Standards: Strictly follow all BACB guidelines and ethical codes of conduct.

• Support the Team: Motivate clients and fellow staff, and assist with clerical or administrative duties as needed.

Why You'll Love Working at MOD (Our Benefits)

We invest in our team. We're proud to offer one of the most supportive environments for RBTs in the field.

D & M Behavioral Solutions of Fort Lauderdale, FL is looking to hire a part-time Lead Registered Behavior Technician (RBT). Are you an experienced RBT who wants to lead without going full-time? Would you like to keep your afternoons and earn lead-level pay? If so, please read on

Join us as the field leader who helps our RBTs deliver consistent, high-quality ABA for every family.

Why Work at D & M Behavioral Solutions?
• Competitive Compensation: $24 - $26 per hour, based on your experience, education, and certifications, paid biweekly by direct deposit.
• Part-Time Flexibility: Part-time, 20-29 hours: afternoon shifts plus one mentoring block. We build your caseload around your availability and neighborhood.
• Health and Wellness: Our PreventivePay wellness program gives you 24/7 virtual urgent care, unlimited virtual doctor visits, and ongoing virtual primary care, with no waiting rooms.
• Mental Health Support: Confidential counseling with licensed mental health counselors, plus unlimited wellness support groups: yoga, sleep coaching, emotional resilience, whole-body wellness coaching, therapeutic art, grief and loss, managing chronic pain, quitting nicotine, a men’s group, and parenting support for moms.
• Real Savings: Free acute medications and up to 80% off other prescriptions at 70,000+ pharmacies, and up to 60% off dental care with 263,000+ dentists, where each family member picks their own dentist.
• Tuition Discount: Through our partnership with Purdue University Global, you and your immediate family (spouse or partner, children, parents, and siblings) save 14% on any graduate program and 20% on any undergraduate program, in fields like psychology and ABA, health sciences, nursing, business, education, human services, and information technology.
• Leadership Time: One scheduled mentoring block each week.
• Mileage: Reimbursed between client locations at the current IRS rate.
• Impactful Work: Help a child say a first word, make a friend, or get through the day with more independence.

A Day in the Life of a Lead Registered Behavior Technician

As a Lead RBT, you are the go-to person in the field. You run your own ABA sessions with families, and you are also the RBT other RBTs call when a program or a behavior gets tricky. You model procedures for newer technicians, cover sessions when a teammate is out, and give your BCBA a front-line read on how each case is really going.

Every month you help shadow new hires, support treatment-integrity checks, and share what you see with our Clinical Director so quality stays high across the team. You love teaching as much as you love therapy, and you take pride in watching the RBTs you mentor grow into confident clinicians.

What Would You Be Doing?
• Delivers ABA sessions with an assigned caseload under BCBA direction.
• Models procedures and gives in-the-field feedback to newer RBTs.
• Covers sessions when teammates are out and supports high-need cases.
• Helps with new-hire shadowing, treatment-integrity checks, and team trainings.
• Shares front-line observations with BCBAs and the Clinical Director.
• Completes accurate data and session notes in ABA Matrix within 24 hours.
• Maintains client confidentiality and follows D & M policies and the RBT Ethics Code.

What Do You Bring to the Role?
• Certification: Current RBT certification in good standing.
• Experience: Five or more years of direct ABA experience (ten or more years for the top of the pay range).
• Experience: Experience mentoring or training other RBTs.
• Transportation: Valid Florida driver license, reliable car, and auto insurance.
• Background: Ability to pass a Florida Level 2 background screening.
• Passion for Children: A genuine love for working with kids and families.
• Positive Attitude: Patience
